tools.description: Network downloader for retrieving files from web servers using HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP
tools.usage:
wget https://example.com/file.zip # Download single file
wget -r -np -k https://site.com/ # Mirror website recursively
wget --user=username --password=pass ftp://server/file # FTP with authentication
wget -c https://large-file.zip # Resume interrupted download
wget -O output.html https://example.com # Save with custom filename
